name: Kaab
desc:
Kaab is a Vesperian NPC. They are a Lifeweaver and [Shipwright](entity:shipwright) for [the Hive](faction:the_hive).

They will only allow you to speak to them until you have reached Ally reputation with [The Hive](faction:the_hive).
additional_info: -   Kaab mentions being able to modify your ship with Lifeweave, though this is not actually possible in game.
